question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**commercial**" refers to activities related to business or commerce. (आर्थिक वाणिज्यिक)
 
• Example: The commercial district is filled with offices and shops.
 
• In the context, **"Residential and commercial buildings use electricity for air-conditioning and lighting and oil and natural gas for heating" **means that both homes and business buildings consume these energy resources.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**commercial**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "*Coal and natural gas-fired power plants generate electricity. Oil-based products such as gasoline, diesel fuel, and aviation fuel provide most of the energy used in transportation. The industry also uses fossil fuels to produce power and heat needed by industrial processes. Residential and **commercial**__ buildings use electricity for air-conditioning and lighting and oil and........."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Privately (निजी तौर पर)**: In a private manner; not publicly.

 
 
• **Example: **She spoke to me privately about her concerns.
 
 
 
• **Demarcate (सीमांकन करना)**: To set the boundaries or limits of something.
 
 
• **Example: **The farm was demarcated by a wooden fence.
 
 
 
• **Natural (प्राकृतिक)**: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.
 
 
• **Example: **Natural resources like forests and water are essential for life.
 
 

41:Td44,
The correct answer is O
